newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates ended steady on Tuesday as spinners hunted for quality stocks but dealers said prices were likely to remain stable as new supplies were flowing in.
"Spinners are a bit concerned about the quality of fresh arrivals," dealer Nasim Usman said. Rising supplies were likely to keep rates stable to firm in the next few sessions, he added.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,150 rupees to 2,000 rupees per maund, dealers said.
